item.text:
This pass covered the last untested membership operation: promoting a live observer to a voting member.

**New test: observer promotion with failover** (`TestAuditObserverPromotion`)

Two-node cluster plus an observer (node 3). After `RequestAddNode(1, 3, addr3, …)`, membership becomes nodes {1,2,3} with no observers. The test then stops the old leader (node 1) and requires the surviving regular node *plus the promoted node* to elect a new leader and commit a proposal — proving the promoted node actually votes. Observed: new leader node 2, proposal committed. Passes 5/5. Promotion had no NodeHost-level test upstream (only raft/rsm unit tests).

**Recorded nuance (not a defect)**

The `RequestAddNode` doc says the target "is ignored when promoting an observer", but `node.requestConfigChange` validates the target before the promotion path, so an empty target yields `ErrInvalidAddress`. Passing the observer's real address works. Noted as a wording/validation-order nuance in the report's observations.

**State**

Five findings unchanged (F1 `(*nodeUser).ReadIndex` wakeup, F2 duplicated dropped-ReadIndex record, F3 `Update.HasUpdate` ignores `DroppedReadIndexes`, F4 channel transport factory panics, F5 logger cache ignores the monkey flag) — all reproduced and all fixed in `audit/diag-fixes/` with the suite green.

The negative-result catalogue now also includes observer promotion with a leadership failover. [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/report.md) is updated; the audited tree remains byte-identical to `../source`.
